description:
Read-only network lookup via GET /v3/ipgeo. Network details require a paid plan. Cost: 1 credit. Returns { network } with route CIDR prefix, connection_type, and is_anycast. If the API omits network data, returns a local error without inventing an HTTP status; credits may already have been used.

ip omitted means the server's public egress IP. force_refresh bypasses cached data, makes a new upstream request, and can consume credits. This response is limited to network data; lookup_ip can return network data together with location, ASN/company, timezone, currency, security, or abuse.

force_refresh.description: Default false. When true, bypasses cached network data; a successful refresh makes a new upstream request and can consume credits.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up. Omit to check the server's public egress IP.

name: lookup_network

data.description: Present on success: API result after field selection, redaction, and transport limits.

error.description: Present on failure, with isError: true.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned in page.cursor or page.next_cursor. Retrieval requires the same server process and API key and does not repeat the original lookup.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp for idle expiry. Successful page reads extend the cache TTL; eviction or process restart can also remove the result.

json_fragment.description: JSON fragment of the original structuredContent. Fragments concatenate in offset order into the complete JSON, including bulk items and errors.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next get_cached_result page, absent on the last page. Page reads never call the API or consume credits.

title: Network/Routing Info
